name: RCECAP
recent: RCE Capital 近期的主要动态是终止 2020 雇员认股计划（2020 ESS）并于 2026 年 10 月 16 日实施新的雇员认股计划（New ESS）。同时，大股东 Amcorp Group Berhad 及相关方在 10 月份多次申报股权变动。最新财报显示季度营收环比和同比均小幅下降，但净利润同比上升。
notable: 终止 2020 雇员认股计划（2020 ESS），未行使的 30,271,000 份现有期权失效并被注销。
新的雇员认股计划（New ESS）于 2026 年 10 月 16 日生效。
大股东 Amcorp Group Berhad 及相关方在 10 月份多次申报股权变动。
risks: 2020 ESS 终止时仍有 30,271,000 份未行使期权，这些期权已失效并被注销。
大股东及相关方在 10 月份多次申报股权变动，需留意后续持股变化。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 MYR 78,386,000，环比下降 1.4%，同比下降 1.8%；净利润为 MYR 30,426,000，环比下降 12.2%，同比上升 17.1%；净利率为 38.8%，低于上一季度的 43.6%。

recent_en: RCE Capital's recent key development is the termination of the 2020 Employees Share Scheme (2020 ESS) and implementation of the New Employees Share Scheme (New ESS) effective 16 October 2026. Meanwhile, substantial shareholder Amcorp Group Berhad and related parties filed multiple changes in shareholding in October. The latest quarterly results show slight declines in revenue both QoQ and YoY, while net income rose YoY.
notable_en: Terminated the 2020 Employees Share Scheme (2020 ESS), with 30,271,000 unexercised existing options lapsing and being cancelled.
The New Employees Share Scheme (New ESS) took effect on 16 October 2026.
Substantial shareholder Amcorp Group Berhad and related parties filed multiple changes in shareholding in October.
risks_en: At termination of the 2020 ESS, 30,271,000 unexercised options remained; these have lapsed and been cancelled.
Substantial shareholder and related parties filed multiple changes in shareholding in October; further changes in holdings should be monitored.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 78,386,000, down 1.4% QoQ and 1.8% YoY; net income was MYR 30,426,000, down 12.2% QoQ but up 17.1% YoY; net margin was 38.8%, lower than 43.6% in the previous quarter.
